feed.headline: Allotted 7,85,300 ordinary shares of one rupee each on 13th November 2026.
feed.subject: ITC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 785300  Shares.
feed.summary: ITC Limited allotted 7,85,300 ordinary shares of one rupee each on 13th November 2026. This allotment resulted from the exercise of 78,530 options by optionees under the company's Employee Stock Option Schemes. The committee meeting for the allotment concluded at 3:10 p.m. Consequently, the issued and subscribed share capital of ITC Limited increased to 1253,26,97,881 rupees. This capital is divided into 1253,26,97,881 ordinary shares of one rupee each. The change is effective from 13th November 2026.
